lookup.title: IDF lookup
lookup.lede: Why this priority: for an item, a store and a payer, the master that decided, the tiers skipped before it and the ranked IDF group.

events.lede: Every IDF moment at the till: what was scanned, what was dispensed, which master decided and how it ended.

filter.label: Filter the events
filter.invalid: Pick a valid from and to date.
filter.reversed: The from date is after the to date.
filter.tooLong: Pick a window of a year or less.
